breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between a 'half-shifted' Monkhorst-Pack mesh and a 'gamma-centered' k-point grid. The ground truth resolves this by removing the contradictory 'gamma-centered' instruction. The generated specification includes both conflicting instructions ('Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift' and 'Keep the k-point grid gamma-centered'), thus repeating the original error.
